name: multi-select
title: Multi Select
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Multi-select with search, removable chips, and the option to create a new value.

meta.descriptionEs: Selector múltiple con búsqueda, chips que se quitan y creación de una opción nueva.

examples.title: Selección múltiple
examples.description: Selector múltiple con búsqueda, chips que se quitan y creación de una opción nueva.

api.name: creatable / onCreate
api.description: Enter on an unknown query creates a chip.

api.name: labels
api.description: placeholder, search, empty, create, and remove labels default to English.

docs: The control is a combobox with a multi-select listbox. Backspace removes the last chip when the query is empty. No theme is shipped.
